retention_tricks: Rapid Cuts: Quick, dynamic edits every 1-3 seconds to maintain visual interest.
Open Loops: Introduce a question or mystery early and resolve it near the end, keeping viewers hooked.
Pattern Interrupts: Unexpected visual or audio changes (e.g., sudden zoom, sound effect, text pop-up) to re-engage attention.
Story Arc: Present a problem, build tension, and offer a solution or reveal, even in short form.
Text Overlays/Captions: Essential for silent viewing and highlighting key points, moving them dynamically.
Emotional Rollercoaster: Elicit a range of emotions (shock, humor, relief) through content and delivery.
